notes: Scheduling is more reliable: if a post can't be scheduled you now see exactly why, videos only get their scheduled badge when the post really lands, a second Schedule click can't double-post, refreshing mid-run picks the progress back up, uploads retry once on a network blip, and the app checks for updates every few hours instead of only at launch.
_urls: urls are GitHub Release assets (stable, public, direct .exe/.dmg) and sha256 pins the exact binary - the 2.9.8+ updater verifies the download against it before offering to install. Assets use customer-friendly names (Remixa-Windows.exe / Remixa-Mac.dmg); the release TAG carries the version. Mac dmg is signed + notarized + stapled (no Gatekeeper warning) from the cloud-Mac CI. Both platforms current as of 2.9.46.
